en.title: New Zealand Disability Support Law Passes, Boosting Accessibility Nationwide
en.summary: New Zealand's Disability Support Services legislation passed its final reading, aiming to improve support for thousands of people with disabilities. Meanwhile, sensor technology advances promise a new era of accessibility for the visually impaired, and HKIRC launches an accessible online shopping platform to promote digital inclusion. Advocacy continues as Dana Fink's legacy is honored and workplace accommodation discussions progress.

zh-TW.title: 新西蘭殘障立法通過
zh-TW.summary: 新西蘭殘障支援服務立法經過最終審議，旨在改善數千名殘障人士的支援。同時，感測器創新為視障者開啟無障礙新時代，HKIRC 推出可及網購平台促進數位共融。此外，殘障倡導者達娜·芬克的遺志被紀念，工作場所合理便利討論持續進行。
